title: Launch bypass / missing onboarding policy
evidence: Normal launch is / Home. Welcome is explicitly a visual-review route; no persisted first-run/revisit gate. This is a confirmed bypass, not proof Welcome is unreachable.
recommendation: Decide optional first-entry policy; preserve deep links and returning walks.

title: Numbered flow differs from actual flow
evidence: 04 → 09 → Build → 05–08 → 09 → retained planner. Design IDs must remain unchanged. This is not an eight-screen mandatory wizard.
recommendation: Decide whether confirmation detour should remain; no automatic flow rewrite.

title: Duration semantics inconsistent across discovery and preview
evidence: Live Hub and Walking Routes advertise 45 min; Preview correctly shows 120 min at stops and unverified walking/total. List filters consume the ambiguous 45-minute field.
recommendation: Editorial/source owner must establish scoped duration; then shared display/filter contract regression.

title: Guest personalization not used in Hub recommendations
evidence: Hub reads accountInterests only when userId matches. NativeWalkFlow holds guest selections in its own mounted state; no durable guest preference handoff to recommendations.
recommendation: Choose ownership of guest defaults and recommendation inputs without duplicating planner state.

title: Unbuilt drafts are not durable
evidence: Screen 08 retains draft via native stack. Build/resume journeys persist; unbuilt interests/return-by/location and completion flags do not have a durable draft contract.
recommendation: Accept session-only draft or authorize a tested shared draft contract; never describe as process-safe.

title: Collection entry inversion
evidence: Only /tour preview contains a navigation reference to /routes in current native code. Hub can open a specific preview; collection discovery comes afterward.
recommendation: Decide explicit route-collection entry while preserving approved visuals.

title: Active-walk modes share Place route and differ in persistence
evidence: Published trip context dispatches to unapproved PublishedActiveWalk. Ordinary places remain Screen 11; custom journeys use NativeWalkFlow. Saved/Trips loads custom/legacy saved walks, not curatedProgressStorage.
recommendation: Review unapproved candidate and resume/Trips discovery before consolidation; do not merge models blindly.

title: Repeated preferences and Skip semantics
evidence: Confirmed repeated question: Screen 05 selects interests, but after 08 returns through Hub, the retained planner step 2 renders the legacy interests grid again (same state), plus categories/walking pace. Step 3 then asks manual/GPS start/end. Available Time Skip advances with current/default budget; rebuild resets interests/time.
recommendation: Decide whether the second interests entry should be editing-only; preserve categories/walking controls and choose Skip/default semantics.

title: Home / Explore tab semantics are conditional
evidence: / has Home; /?section=cities and /city/:citySlug have Explore. /walk and /tour have Trips. /routes currently falls through to Explore. This differs from catalog/preview tab expectations but is not a proven crash.
recommendation: Approve tab ownership before any route/active-tab changes.

title: Multiple search/filter presentations
evidence: Hub places filters, Explore list/map and dedicated Search/recent history overlap. Search limits visible matches to 12; Explore is full catalog. Removal would lose capabilities.
recommendation: Merge best capabilities only after search/history/category/map regression matrix.

title: Guide/audio claims remain availability bounded
evidence: City Assistant is explicitly unavailable with a place-discovery fallback. Real Guide is place-scoped. English Holstentor capture has no English audio; no substituted-locale playback.
recommendation: Keep honest capability-specific paths; verify deployed provider/locale integration separately.

title: Photography and attribution coverage incomplete
evidence: Recorded audit: 20 missing POI images + four unverified legacy assets, all excluded/fallbacks. Current Explore still contains adjacent licensed text; Detail uses central Photo Credits. No new license compliance opinion established by this audit.
recommendation: Preserve source/license metadata and per-license handling; approved asset acquisition is a separate task.

title: Snapshot is behind current integration branches
evidence: Redesign base 98a1… differs from live develop 9f847…; #449/#450/#452 merged separately. Some #450 progress was locally reused, but branch ancestry and partial copies do not prove all backend/shared/native contracts are integrated. #454 remains a separate open selected-place UI PR.
recommendation: No-loss source→successor comparison and exact revision regression required before any merge; preserve independent worktrees.

title: Legacy selected-city assumptions remain outside redesigned flow
evidence: Authenticated /account has a city pass card/link explicitly for lubeck. Dynamic city context in 04/09/10 does not make that legacy account area globally city-aware.
recommendation: Choose account/pass scoping independently; do not modify commerce in this audit.

title: Product-wide device/back/provider acceptance is incomplete
evidence: Historical reports document tests/simulator evidence with unverified Android devices, physical VoiceOver/TalkBack, live OAuth/email/purchases, process-death draft behavior and full back-stack traversal. Audit captures do not close these gates.
recommendation: Require explicit per-platform, guest/account, locale, restart and provider acceptance before removal or release.
